service.description: The releases of the catalog at maps@overture-catalog (Overture's STAC root when empty), the newest first, each {version, latest}; refused (valid false) while outside requests are off and when the catalog does not read.

Read run importId's theme for its region from its release (moqui-maps: the release's catalog and schema version, the items whose extent meets the region, each GeoParquet file by range, only the row groups whose box statistics meet it and only the theme's columns). Places are written as the run's OverturePlace rows in batches of 2,000, a transaction each; Buildings answer the footprints as a PMTiles archive (bytes). The counts are written to the run as it goes and its cancelRequested read then. valid false with reasonCode and reason when it does not complete; cancelled true when it was cancelled. Addresses are written as the run's OvertureAddress rows in batches of 2,000 (at most 1,000,000 a run), with countryCodes, and changes: what the release changed against the run active now, by address (country, street, number, unit and postal code; never by GERS ID): {comparedWith, added, removed, moved (more than 25 m), unchanged}.

The local geocoder's search (MPK_GEOCODER_OVERTURE, MapGeocoders.js) of the address points of the active Addresses runs: the text read into number, street, unit, postal code and locality (as an address of country, else of each country of the active runs), the rows of its street and number read by their indexed keys (case, diacritics and the street words of the country's languages folded), ranked: number and street matched an address match (GPP_ADDRESS_MATCH; a source's position kind is not stated), the postal code agreeing then the locality; points of one address within 30 m one candidate; candidates within 15 points of the best choices (ambiguous); a number found without its suffix, and a street without the number, estimates (GPP_PLACE_ESTIMATE). No outside request, and nothing written. reasonCode NO_DATA (no Addresses run active), QUERY_UNREAD (no street in the text) or NO_MATCH, with parsed (the parts read) for the postal fallback.

parameter.name: viewport
parameter.description: west, south, east, north: its middle breaks ties

service.description: What Maps › Configuration › Overture shows: each theme with its licenses, attribution, obligations and acknowledgement; each region with its themes' active and previous runs, last run and layer; the last 50 runs; whether this server has the overture feature, whether outside requests are on, and the largest region (maps@overture-max-area, km²).
The catalog's releases for the region form (read#OvertureReleases), newest first; refused while outside requests are off or without the overture feature.
Acknowledge a theme's license and attribution (who and when, in the audit log), and with licenses the further source licenses a run found (newLicenses), which the acknowledgement covers from then on.

parameter.name: licenses
parameter.description: SPDX IDs to add to those the acknowledgement covers

service.description: Add or change a region: a name, its box (west less than east, south less than north, within longitude and latitude, not across the antimeridian, at most maps@overture-max-area km²), the release its next import reads (empty for the catalog's latest then), the profile its Buildings layer is shown in, and the themes it imports (themeIds; a theme left out is not removed, Remove does that).

Start an import of a theme of a region as a run of the OvertureImport ServiceJob, never in the request: a pending run (OviPending) pinned to releaseVersion (else the region's, else the catalog's latest now). Refused, with no run: no overture feature in this server (OVERTURE_NOT_BUILT), outside requests off (EXTERNAL_REQUESTS_OFF), the theme's license not acknowledged (LICENSE_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED), a region over maps@overture-max-area (REGION_TOO_LARGE), a run of the region and theme in progress (RUN_IN_PROGRESS; one with no word for an hour is taken as abandoned and failed). force accepts a release with far fewer rows than the active one.

The OvertureImport ServiceJob's run of a pending run, as the administrator who started it (their own grant asked again, with the feature, outside requests and the license): read#OvertureTheme stages its rows or archive; then it is checked, writing nothing in use: a run with no rows, or with fewer than half the active run's rows unless forced, fails; one whose sources name a license the theme's acknowledgement does not cover waits for review (OviReview: staged, not active), as one whose sources name no license (UNKNOWN); one cancelled or ended as abandoned while it read is not activated. Otherwise it is activated (activate#OvertureImport's step). A run that fails or is cancelled deletes its own staged rows and archive; the active run stays as it was. Its results name the statusId, for the job's notification (topic OvertureImport).

Ask a run in progress to stop: a pending run is cancelled at once; a reading one stops at its next row group, deleting what it staged; one with no word for an hour is taken as abandoned and failed at once.

Activate a run that waits for review (OviReview), once its theme's acknowledgement covers the licenses it found (LICENSE_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED otherwise) and it started after the active run (OLDER_THAN_ACTIVE otherwise): in one transaction the region theme's active run becomes it and the run active before it the previous one (kept for rollback); for Buildings, the region's layer is registered to the run's archive (MapSourceServices.register#ArchiveLayer: a map drawing the old revision is refused it and loads again) and added to the region's profile; the region theme's other runs waiting for review are superseded. Then those and the runs older than the previous one are removed (their rows and archives).
Discard a run that waits for license review (OviDiscarded): its staged rows and archive are deleted, and the active release stays.

Make a region theme's previous run active again (its rows and archive were kept; Buildings' layer is registered to its archive again), and remove the run that was active (OviRolledBack). Refused when there is no previous run (NOTHING_TO_ROLL_BACK) or a run is in progress.

Remove a theme of a region, or with no themeId every theme of it and the region: the rows and archives of its runs, its layer (and the profiles' references to it); the run history stays (OviRemoved). Refused while a run is in progress.

The maps.overture readiness provider, changing nothing, for a caller with ADMIN_OVERVIEW_VIEW: regions are there but this server lacks the overture feature (NOT_BUILT); a run waits for license review (REVIEW); the last run of a region theme failed (IMPORT_FAILED); each active run's release.
